<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Production-friendly authentication helpers.
 *
 * This file provides a compact, maintainable authentication service layer
 * focused on predictable control flow, strict input validation, and safe
 * password handling.
 */

final class AuthenticationResult
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly bool $success,
        public readonly ?array $user = null,
        public readonly ?string $message = null
    ) {
    }
}

final class AuthenticationService
{
    /** @var callable */
    private $userFetcher;

    /** @var callable */
    private $passwordVerifier;

    /** @var callable|null */
    private $auditLogger;

    public function __construct(
        callable $userFetcher,
        ?callable $passwordVerifier = null,
        ?callable $auditLogger = null
    ) {
        $this->userFetcher = $userFetcher;
        $this->passwordVerifier = $passwordVerifier ?? static fn (string $password, string $hash): bool => password_verify($password, $hash);
        $this->auditLogger = $auditLogger;
    }

    public function authenticate(string $identifier, string $password): AuthenticationResult
    {
        $identifier = $this->normalizeIdentifier($identifier);

        if ($identifier === '' || $password === '') {
            $this->log('authentication.failed', ['reason' => 'missing_credentials', 'identifier' => $identifier]);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Invalid credentials.');
        }

        $user = $this->fetchUser($identifier);
        if ($user === null) {
            $this->log('authentication.failed', ['reason' => 'user_not_found', 'identifier' => $identifier]);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Invalid credentials.');
        }

        if (!$this->isAccountEligible($user)) {
            $this->log('authentication.failed', [
                'reason' => 'account_ineligible',
                'identifier' => $identifier,
                'user_id' => $user['id'] ?? null,
            ]);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Account is unavailable.');
        }

        $hash = (string) ($user['password_hash'] ?? '');
        if ($hash === '' || !$this->verifyPassword($password, $hash)) {
            $this->log('authentication.failed', [
                'reason' => 'password_mismatch',
                'identifier' => $identifier,
                'user_id' => $user['id'] ?? null,
            ]);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Invalid credentials.');
        }

        $sanitizedUser = $this->sanitizeUser($user);
        $this->log('authentication.succeeded', [
            'identifier' => $identifier,
            'user_id' => $sanitizedUser['id'] ?? null,
        ]);

        return new AuthenticationResult(true, $sanitizedUser, null);
    }

    private function fetchUser(string $identifier): ?array
    {
        $user = ($this->userFetcher)($identifier);

        return is_array($user) ? $user : null;
    }

    private function verifyPassword(string $password, string $hash): bool
    {
        return (bool) ($this->passwordVerifier)($password, $hash);
    }

    private function normalizeIdentifier(string $identifier): string
    {
        return trim(mb_strtolower($identifier));
    }

    private function isAccountEligible(array $user): bool
    {
        if (array_key_exists('is_deleted', $user) && (bool) $user['is_deleted']) {
            return false;
        }

        if (array_key_exists('is_active', $user) && !(bool) $user['is_active']) {
            return false;
        }

        if (array_key_exists('status', $user)) {
            $status = strtolower((string) $user['status']);
            if (in_array($status, ['disabled', 'deleted', 'blocked', 'suspended'], true)) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function sanitizeUser(array $user): array
    {
        unset(
            $user['password'],
            $user['password_hash'],
            $user['reset_token'],
            $user['remember_token'],
            $user['two_factor_secret']
        );

        return $user;
    }

    private function log(string $event, array $context = []): void
    {
        if ($this->auditLogger !== null) {
            ($this->auditLogger)($event, $context);
        }
    }
}

if (!function_exists('authenticate_user')) {
    /**
     * Thin convenience wrapper for projects that prefer a functional API.
     *
     * Expected $userFetcher behavior:
     * - input: normalized identifier (username/email)
     * - output: associative array with at least password_hash and optionally id/status flags
     */
    function authenticate_user(
        string $identifier,
        string $password,
        callable $userFetcher,
        ?callable $auditLogger = null
    ): array {
        $service = new AuthenticationService($userFetcher, null, $auditLogger);
        $result = $service->authenticate($identifier, $password);

        return [
            'success' => $result->success,
            'user' => $result->user,
            'message' => $result->message,
        ];
    }
}
